contract: v6 S1 FIT SPEC v3 (input stage). Supersedes v2 (arm S1-A2 REJECTED, see REJECTED_ARMS.md); frozen and committed before this fit runs
scope: Per-type parameters of R1-R6 only: phototransduction (G, Ka, tau_p0) and the R1-R6 release sigmoid (gain, vh, s). No edge, no base weight, no other type changes. Base weights untouched; 'gain' is recorded as an EFFECTIVE release gain of the presynaptic type R1-R6.
engine: brainlab/v6_calibrated.py (advance_v6 == advance_v4 with empty parameters; tests/test_v6_calibrated.py)
compute_limit: CPU only, <= 4 cores (taskset 0-3, nice), reduced single-cell models; no GPU
intensity_units: light I in units of JH2001 BG0 (~3e6 photons/s)
encoder_mapping_rationale: the Path B encoder levels (BASE 10, ON 20, OFF 0) become light 0.1 (= BG-1), 0.2 and darkness. Declared before any fit; not tuned.

phototransduction.model: dead time D, n first-order stages with tau = tau_p0/(1+a/Kt) (speed-up) , adaptation a = low-pass(y, tau_a), light conductance G*y/(1+a/Ka) (gain control) reversing at 0 mV; R membrane tau_m 20 ms
phototransduction.fixed_rationale: D = JH2001 BG0 dead time (~10 ms). n = 4 and tau_a = 200 ms are ENGINEERING ASSUMPTIONS (not in the pinned text).
phototransduction.observation_model: engine R rest -52 mV, ceiling 0 mV (52 mV available). JH2001 max dark impulse 60-75 mV of a ~75-85 mV range to the light reversal -> mapped to 0.85 of the available range = 44 mV.

T1_dark_flash_peak_mV.source: JH2001 max dark impulse (1-ms flash, 3.3 x BG0), mapped as above

T2_BG0_plateau_frac.source: JH2001: BG0 steady state = 39 +- 9 % of max dark impulse

T3_tp_BG0_ms.source: JH2001 Fig. 6H text: impulse time to peak ~20 ms at BG0

phototransduction.optimiser: Nelder-Mead on log-parameters WITH bounds, 3 fixed starts
phototransduction.refit: NOT refitted: the S1-A2 phototransduction (it met every train target) is carried over unchanged and its held-out result (H1 pass, H2 fail) stands

release.model: ADAPTIVE sigmoid: x = gain*R_MAX*dt/(1+exp(-(V_R - vh_eff)/s)), vh_eff = vh0 + kappa*(m - V_rest), m = low-pass(V_R, tau_s). Light adaptation of the R->LMC synapse (JUUSOLA1995: synaptic amplification depends on background).
release.reduced_lamina_model: one L cell per type (L1, L2, L3; right eye, COMPLETE columns, >= 1 R input): W = median summed |w| from R1-R6 (engine v4 policy weights, scripts/v6/r_to_l_weights.py); the non-R tonic conductances ge_o, gi_o are solved from the Path B v4 sham V_B and gtot_B after subtracting the v4 R contribution, then held fixed

V_dark.source: ZHENG2006 LMC rest -40..-70 mV (midpoint; engine floor -70)

frac.source: ZHENG2006 LMC saturating light-pulse hyperpolarisation >40, up to 45 mV from a -40..-70 rest: near the full range; observation = fraction of (V_dark - E_inh) reached by the dark-adapted 1-ms 3.3 x BG0 flash

amp_BG0.source: JUUSOLA1995 (blowfly) synaptic amplification ~4 at the brightest background, mapped to BG0; observation = peak |dV_L| / peak dV_R for a +0.5 contrast step (I: B -> 1.5 B, 300 ms) after 3 s adaptation to B

release.selection_rule: minimum cost over the s grid (all three targets constrain s through amp_BG0); ties within 0.05 resolved to the larger s
release.frac_guard: if V_dark - E_inh < 0.01 mV the fraction is scored 0
release.fixed_rationale: kappa = 1 (the curve re-centres fully on the slow mean) and tau_s = 200 ms are ENGINEERING ASSUMPTIONS; the pinned texts give no number for either

H1_tp_BG-4_ms.source: JH2001: tp ~40 ms at the lowest background

H2_plateau_ratio_BG-1_over_BG0.source: JH2001: BG-1 ~20 mV above rest; BG0 28 mV above BG-4

H3_LMC_sign_on_increment.source: BORST2025 RF_sign -1 for L1-L3 (calcium sign only)

H4_amp_BG-3.5.source: JUUSOLA1995 ~10 at 3.5 log units below the brightest background (mapped to BG-3.5)

fit_pass_rule: S1 fit PASSES if every train target is within tol (release cost <= accept_cost, averaged over L1-L3) and >= 3 of the 4 held-out checks (H1, H2, H3, H4) are inside accept; otherwise REJECTED and recorded. H2 is already known to fail (S1-A2).
